At first light

Begin with the Ganga.

Meet Varanasi from the riverfront. The early light brings the ghats, boats and steps into view as the city begins its day.

Boat rides are available around Dashashwamedh Ghat. Agree the route and fare locally before setting out.

Explore the riverfront

A visit to Kashi

A place of devotion.

Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas. It lies within walking distance of Augusto.

Check the temple’s current visitor instructions before you leave. Give this part of the day its own space.

Plan your first visit

Between visits

Leave room for a pause.

Make your way through the old city at your own pace. Godowlia is your base, with a room and vegetarian dining to return to at Augusto.

Keep the hotel’s map pin handy and speak with the team if you need help planning your arrival or return.

Dining at Augusto

Back by the ghats

An evening at the aarti.

Dashashwamedh Ghat comes together for the evening Ganga Aarti. Lamps, chants and bells are part of the experience by the river.

Leave time to reach the ghat and find a place to take it in. Confirm the day’s arrangements locally.

Discover the evening aarti
